scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix app install && cd app && npx expo install --fix
scripts.start: concurrently -k --handle-input --default-input-target app -n server,app -c blue,green "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix app start"
scripts.android: concurrently -k --handle-input --default-input-target app -n server,app -c blue,green "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix app run android"
scripts.ios: concurrently -k --handle-input --default-input-target app -n server,app -c blue,green "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix app run ios"
